methods.description: The sole attributable canonical invocation at the original final timed out after 300 seconds inside its combined owner-test subprocess and was sealed INVALID with zero canonical success credit.

The immutable failed receipt was hashed and read by exact keys, isolating TimeoutExpired as the only reached failure; the additive correction changes only the owner-test subprocess timeout from 300 to 900 seconds and binds a new corrected-final topology and latch.
The first validator-inspection rg expression had an unclosed noncapturing group and was rejected before searching, so it earned zero inspection credit and changed no repository byte.
A literal multi-pattern rg query recovered the exact test-count, detailed-count, receipt-total, manifest, and lifecycle lines without regex grouping.
